fields.title: Estimate Volume
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: It is proposed to store all user search queries for 2 years. 180k active users, 3 searches per session, 1.4 sessions per day, 250 bytes per write.
fields.promptBlocks/1/items/1: What product question does this raise?
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: 180,000 × 3 × 1.4 × 365 × 2 × 250 bytes ≈ 138 GB. Magnitude — hundreds of gigabytes, acceptable. The product question is not about volume, but privacy: search queries are personal data, and two years of storage requires justification under `DS2-N6`. The estimation answers "storage is possible", but the decision is still made on other grounds.
